Casos.descripcion: Explore some of the projects where we have supported our clients with solutions designed around their operations.
Casos.texto0: Connectivity and video surveillance in one project. At Servicentro San Juan, SG Solutions integrated the network infrastructure and IP camera system, with equipment organized in cabinets and a screen to view the monitored areas.
Casos.situacion0: The project covered business connectivity and a camera system for monitoring its different areas.
Casos.respuesta0: The network infrastructure, communications cabinet and IP camera system with centralized viewing were implemented.
Casos.valorado0: Connected operations and a central view of monitored areas through a system prepared for support and maintenance.
Casos.alt0_0: Exterior of Servicentro San Juan with the SG Solutions technical support vehicle.
Casos.alt0_1: Communications cabinet and monitor showing the IP cameras installed at Servicentro San Juan.
Casos.titulo1: Point-of-sale stations and technology infrastructure for pharmacies
Casos.texto1: Technology for customer service across ECOFARMA pharmacies. The project integrates point-of-sale stations with barcode scanners, receipt printers and cash drawers, along with cabinets that organize and protect the technology infrastructure at each location.
Casos.situacion1: Counter service and organization of the technology infrastructure across the pharmacies.
Casos.respuesta1: Stations were installed with monitors, keyboards, barcode scanners, receipt printers and cash drawers, along with cabinets for the technology equipment.
Casos.valorado1: Equipped service points and organized infrastructure that support operations across the different pharmacies.
Casos.alt1_0: ECOFARMA storefront with the SG Solutions technical support vehicle.
Casos.alt1_1: ECOFARMA point-of-sale station with monitor, barcode scanner, receipt printer and cash drawer.
Casos.alt1_2: Wall-mounted equipment cabinet installed at ECOFARMA.
Casos.titulo2: Point-of-sale stations and IP surveillance camera system
Casos.texto2: Point-of-sale stations and IP surveillance for Eco Mini Market. Our team worked on installing the service stations and the store’s camera system, bringing together the equipment and peripherals used in the business’s operations.
Casos.situacion2: The store required point-of-sale stations and IP video surveillance to support its operations.
Casos.respuesta2: The point-of-sale equipment was installed and configured along with the IP cameras intended for store surveillance.
Casos.valorado2: Equipment ready for operation and a surveillance solution prepared according to the establishment’s needs.
Casos.alt2_0: SG Solutions team installing point-of-sale stations at Eco Mini Market.
Casos.alt2_1: Exterior of Eco Mini Market with the SG Solutions technical support vehicle in front of the store.
Casos.alt2_2: IP cameras prepared for installation at Eco Mini Market.
Casos.texto3: A comprehensive technology solution designed to connect and protect the hospital’s different areas. SG Solutions implemented its network infrastructure, video surveillance, attendance control, computer equipment, telephone system and alarm system, from design through commissioning.
Casos.situacion3: The hospital needed to bring connectivity, security and operational technology together within a single project.
Casos.respuesta3: Six complementary areas were designed and implemented: network, cameras, attendance, computing, telephony and alarm.
Casos.valorado3: An integrated infrastructure prepared to support patient care, internal communications and facility protection.
Casos.alt3_0: Exterior of Hospital Veterinario de Occidente with the SG Solutions vehicle in front of the facility.
Casos.alt3_1: Main cabinet housing the network infrastructure and technology equipment at Hospital Veterinario de Occidente.
Casos.alt3_2: Wireless access point installed at Hospital Veterinario de Occidente.

terminos.descripcion: Conditions for browsing products, requesting services and arranging orders with SG Solutions.

0.titulo: Who we are and how to contact us
0.texto: SG Solutions is the trading name of 3-101-951810 Sociedad Anónima. Contact us at asesor@sgsolutionscr.com or +506 2446-7846. You can also use our WhatsApp buttons. Our office is at Centro Comercial Plaza El Bosque, unit 9, Mercedes, Atenas, Alajuela, Costa Rica.

1.texto:
Product prices are in Costa Rican colones and include VAT. Shipping is shown separately and included in the total before you complete your order. The catalogue is updated using supplier information; stock is checked again when processing a purchase and adding an item to the cart does not reserve it. The item delivered must match the model and specifications offered. Ask us to clarify any discrepancy in a photograph or product description; we will not substitute the model without your authorization. If an error or discrepancy is found, we will inform you and request your acceptance before changing the product or amount; if you decline and have already paid, we will arrange the applicable refund.

Items labelled “Check availability” require SG Solutions to confirm availability and conditions; a WhatsApp enquiry does not charge you. Digital licenses sourced on order are not physical stock held in our store.

2.texto: You can buy as a guest or sign in to use your saved details. Before completing your order, you can review and correct products, quantities, contact details, delivery and payment. Adding to the cart or reviewing an order does not charge you. Completing the process provides an order reference and status. A pending or declined payment, or a receipt awaiting verification, is not a confirmed payment. SG Solutions coordinates delivery and communicates status changes; submitting a request alone does not guarantee a supplier reservation.

3.texto: You can pay by SINPE Móvil, bank transfer or card through Tilopay. SINPE and bank transfers require an attached receipt; SG Solutions verifies the funds before confirming payment. Full card details and the security code are sent directly from your browser to Tilopay; SG Solutions does not store them. The summary shows the total and the cost of your selected delivery method: store pickup or shipping. The maximum delivery period is 7 business days after payment confirmation. It includes sourcing and preparation of the order, plus transport where applicable, and applies to store pickup, Correos de Costa Rica, Express and digital licenses. Express may arrive sooner, without guaranteeing immediate delivery. Any different timeframe must be agreed before payment. We will inform you of any delay; this does not automatically extend the deadline or remove your rights regarding non-performance. Provide accurate billing and delivery information; contact the team with your reference if you need to correct it.

4.texto:
Products and services have the legal warranty applicable in Costa Rica and the specific conditions communicated for each product. For warranties, incorrect deliveries, cancellations or returns, contact asesor@sgsolutionscr.com or +506 2446-7846 with your reference and reason. Where the right of withdrawal applies, you can exercise it within eight business days after the sale is concluded, through the original purchase channel or our contact channels. We will explain how to return the item and process reimbursement under applicable rules. A convenience return does not replace rights relating to defects or non-performance. You are not required to handle warranty claims solely with the manufacturer and do not waive your rights to repair, replacement or refund.

The minimum warranty is thirty business days from delivery or service provision, without reducing any longer warranty offered. Complaints will be answered within ten business days. For a valid withdrawal, reimbursement uses the original payment method within the statutory eight calendar days, starting the day after notice or return of the goods, as applicable.

5.texto:
An inquiry or plan request does not automatically activate a service or subscription. Diagnosis, scope, price, hours, response times, visits, term and cancellation conditions will be detailed in the accepted proposal. Response time is not a resolution deadline. Authorization and necessary data handling will be arranged before work on equipment or remote access. We recommend keeping current backups; this does not release SG Solutions from its legal responsibilities.

For digital licenses, review the product, user count, duration and compatibility in the product description. Delivery is arranged to the order email address; activation may require an account with the manufacturer. Do not send your password. Purchasing does not authorize recurring charges from SG Solutions. Being digital or sourced on order does not automatically exclude statutory warranty or withdrawal rights; any applicable restriction must be disclosed before purchase.

6.titulo: Use of the site and content
6.texto: Protect your credentials and use a unique password. You can sign in with email and password or Google when available. Your details and purchases are shown only in your account; administrative access requires a specific permission. Do not share passwords or access codes with our staff. Provide accurate, authorized information and do not use the site for impersonation or unauthorized access. Brands, photographs and content belong to their respective owners; their presence does not imply any additional affiliation beyond what is expressly stated. External links are also governed by their providers’ terms.

7.texto: These conditions are interpreted under Costa Rican law. Updates will show their date and will not retroactively change agreed conditions. Nothing here waives consumer rights or prevents recourse to competent authorities. Data handling is explained in the Privacy Policy.

privacidad.descripcion: How we handle your data when browsing, creating an account, purchasing or requesting assistance.

0.texto: 3-101-951810 Sociedad Anónima, trading as SG Solutions, is responsible for data received through the website and its contact channels. For privacy questions, data requests or security incidents, write to asesor@sgsolutionscr.com or contact +506 2446-7846. Our office is at Centro Comercial Plaza El Bosque, unit 9, Mercedes, Atenas, Alajuela, Costa Rica.

1.texto: We receive the details you provide for your account, purchase or enquiry: name, email, phone, identification where required, billing information, delivery address and recipient, products, messages and payment receipts. If you are signed in, we update purchase details in your profile when you review an order to make future purchases easier; you can correct them in My account. When signing in with Google, we receive the basic identity information and email authorized by that provider; we do not request access to Gmail, Drive or your Google password. SG Solutions account passwords are managed as hashes by Supabase Auth, not as readable text. Do not include passwords, access codes, full card numbers or sensitive information in messages or receipts.

2.texto: We use your data to authenticate your account, show your purchases, fill in checkout with details you have saved, respond to enquiries, process payments, invoice, coordinate delivery, provide support, handle warranties and claims, and meet legal obligations. If you do not provide required details, we cannot complete the service that needs them; you can browse the catalogue without creating an account. Optional fields can be left blank. Registering or buying does not authorize marketing messages. Optional advertising is controlled separately through Privacy preferences. Our own aggregate counters are described below and are not used to recognize visitors. We do not sell your personal data.

3.texto:
Supabase manages authentication and data storage; Cloudflare hosts the website and processes technical connection and security information; Brevo sends confirmation, recovery and order emails; Google participates when you choose that sign-in method. Tilopay processes card details and payment; SG Solutions receives the transaction reference and status without storing the full card number or security code. Product suppliers and delivery services receive only the details needed to fulfil your order where applicable. These providers may process information outside Costa Rica. WhatsApp, Outlook, maps and social networks apply their own policies when you open their links.

The absence of identifiers in counters does not make the entire platform anonymous: authentication, orders and connection services may process personal data and technical records to operate and protect the service.

4.texto:
The sg-idioma cookie remembers your language for up to one year. The cart and local favorites remain in this browser until you remove them or clear site data. When you sign in, favorites are added to your account for access on other devices; you can remove them from Favorites. They do not authorize advertising.

Authentication cookies maintain your session. Temporary sign-in cookies protect sign-in and allow a return to checkout; the return cookie lasts up to one hour. Reviewing an order while signed in updates purchase details in your profile.

Checkout keeps a draft in this tab’s session storage, including contact, billing and delivery details you have entered. It expires 30 minutes after its last save and is purged during navigation, on focus and periodically while the site is open. Persistent drafts from earlier versions are removed when you return to the site. Signing out requests cleanup in this tab and other open tabs able to receive the notification. Receipt files and card details are not stored. Payment return may keep technical references in tab session storage for up to 24 hours; it no longer copies form details in plain text into those references. On shared devices, sign out and clear site data when finished.

Our own counters aggregate pages and interactions by day, general device type and language. They do not store IP addresses, visitor or session identifiers, individual histories, free-text searches or forms. Data older than 30 days is purged when new events arrive. These are totals, not unique visitors. Purchases are calculated separately from orders with confirmed payment.

Administrative exclusion stores the same sg-excluir-medicion=1 flag in administrative browsers, using a cookie lasting up to one year and local storage. It remains after signing out and contains no personal identifier. A new or private browser, or one with cleared storage, does not retain this exclusion.

Recommendations use up to 20 product references in memory during current browsing and may consider your favorites when signed in. In-memory references disappear on reload or closing the page; they are not a synchronized history. Without available interests, SG Solutions selections and aggregate popularity are used.

Your advertising preference is saved in this browser. Only a current advertising choice creates sg-publicidad: a protected cookie lasting up to 30 days, containing technical attribution identifiers and the first known and recent sources. No account journey is created. UTM values are reduced to approved campaigns; measurement does not retain written searches, complete URLs or messages. Advertising events are sent to Meta from the server without customer names, emails, phone numbers, identification, addresses, account details or the visitor IP in the payload. Advertising identifiers are pseudonymous, not completely anonymous. Internal counters remain separate.

You can withdraw permission in Privacy preferences. The cookie is removed and pending sends are suppressed when revocation is processed; this feature cannot withdraw events Meta has already received. Sending is retried up to five times within 48 hours. Attribution and status records are deleted after 30 days through periodic cleanup while the job is operational. Technical identifiers are removed from the queue when delivery finishes. An older pixel consent does not automatically activate this measurement.

The temporary sg-limpiar-compra cookie requests draft cleanup after sign-out or account deactivation; it lasts up to one minute and is removed when processed. It contains a fixed instruction, not your identity.

A local sign-out counter (sg-compra-cierre) lets suspended tabs detect pending cleanup when resumed. It contains no account or device identifier and is not sent to analytics.

5.texto:
Access is limited to you, authorized SG Solutions staff and providers necessary for the stated purpose. We retain your profile while you maintain your account and orders, invoices, receipts and security records for as long as needed to handle them and meet legal obligations. You may request account deletion; purchase records required for tax obligations, warranties or claims are not automatically removed. Deleting an account does not itself cancel an order or payment. Communication providers also maintain their own retention periods.

Deactivating your account in My account does not immediately erase all data. To request deletion or learn what information must be retained and why, use the privacy contact. We do not claim that all provider records or backups are deleted immediately.

6.titulo: Your rights and how to exercise them
6.texto: You can view and correct saved details in My account and request access, correction, updates, deletion or withdrawal of consent under Law 8968. For other requests, write to asesor@sgsolutionscr.com with what you need and a reply channel. We will request only the verification necessary to protect your identity. You may withdraw consent through a method equivalent to the one used to provide it; this does not affect previous actions or legal retention obligations. You may also contact the Costa Rican Data Protection Agency (PRODHAB). Exercising these rights is free of charge, and we will resolve your request within the statutory five business days of receipt, with appropriate identity verification. Do not send passwords or authentication codes when exercising these rights.

7.texto: Processing must be limited to the stated purpose and the access needed to fulfill it. No Internet channel is risk-free; avoid sharing unnecessary information. This policy will be updated when services or data use change, with a revision date. New processing requiring consent is not authorized merely by publishing an update.
